prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a parking lot collision in Baytown, Texas, and has back strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1335; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather not give my full name on a recording, but I'll confirm I'm the driver of the vehicle involved in the parking lot incident.

Q: Understood. Can you describe what happened in the parking lot?

A: I was pulling out of a space near the store entrance, moving slowly. Another vehicle backed out from the row across from me without stopping. I braked hard, but the rear corner of their car hit my driver side door.

Q: Were you wearing a seatbelt at the time?

A: Yes, I was.

Q: Did you feel any injuries immediately after the collision?

A: Not right away. I felt a tightness in my lower back later that evening, and by the next morning it was worse. Turning to get out of bed was painful.

Q: Have you sought medical treatment for your back?

A: Yes, I saw a doctor at an urgent care clinic in Baytown. They diagnosed a back strain and gave me muscle relaxers and instructions to rest and use heat.

Q: Do you have any prior problems with your lower back?

A: I had some stiffness years ago after lifting something heavy, but nothing that required treatment. It had been fine for a long time before this.

Q: Are you still experiencing pain?

A: Yes, sitting for long periods is uncomfortable, and I've had to limit my driving. I'm taking time off work until the doctor clears me.

Q: Thank you. Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?

A: No, I think that covers it. I'll send over the medical paperwork when I receive it.

Q: Thank you for your time. This concludes the statement.
